test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All wires are switches.

No switch is a pipe.

All bulbs are pipes.

**Conclusions:**

I. No wire is a pipe.

II. No bulb is a switch.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The logic followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/303094b31ea5d23f8a5f7a3863c43958c17c265d18af98a394a188ce1a67ba5f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b39c97811b5ae5b5a59df34a455bab4e343c925259c04177739e8dbda0e302a3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No wire is a pipe → **True** (All wires are switches and no switch is a pipe implies that no wire is a pipe).

II. No bulb is a switch → **True** (All bulbs are pipes, and no switch is a pipe implies that no bulb is a switch).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Both conclusions I and II follow"**.
